name: ZB Exchange
rootCause: The ZB exchange was hacked with a total loss of around $4.3 million. ZB has notified the community on August 2 that deposits and withdrawals will be suspended due to a "sudden failure". The reason is "Sudden failure of the core application". It's worth noting that the attack actually happened on August 1, but it was overshadowed by the overwhelming news of the Nomad exploit.

descriptions.text: The ZB exchange was hacked with a total loss of around $4.3 million. ZB has notified the community on August 2 that deposits and withdrawals will be suspended due to a "sudden failure". The reason is "Sudden failure of the core application". It's worth noting that the attack actually happened on August 1, but it was overshadowed by the overwhelming news of the Nomad exploit.

ZB Exchange's hot wallet was compromised on August 1, 2022, resulting in the theft of approximately $4.8 million across multiple tokens. The attacker used the stolen private key with apparent insider access, quickly liquidated most assets for ETH, and moved the proceeds. No funds have been recovered, and the exchange provided minimal disclosure. Hot wallet key compromise enabled unauthorized withdrawals; loss resulted from insufficient isolation and/or operational security of the exchange's custodial wallet.
